title: 如何复盘 Starbucks 2025 年 Green Apron Service 推广首月？
topic: 向门店负责人汇报服务项目推广、员工支持和早期反馈

source.title: Message from Brian: Green Apron Service, one month in
source.type: 星巴克 CEO 发给员工的服务项目进展信
source.context: 向门店负责人汇报服务项目推广、员工支持和早期反馈
paragraphs: Last week, we celebrated a record-breaking Fall launch. Today, I want to recognize another milestone. We’re one month into the nationwide rollout of Green Apron Service, and the momentum is building in our coffeehouses.

We built Green Apron Service with our green apron partners, and it’s grounded in what you told us you need and what works. It includes more store level ownership, more partner hours, larger rosters, Smart Queue technology, five key moments and coffeehouse walks. It’s already helping us deliver better throughput in the morning and through the balance of day, while creating more time for customer connection and service.

Customers are noticing the difference in every way they access Starbucks — in cafes, in the drive thru and via mobile orders. Partners are telling us it’s making their jobs more focused and more fulfilling. It’s the Starbucks experience at its best, and we are on our way to reclaiming being the world’s greatest customer experience.

Since launching our “Back to Starbucks” plan, we have walked the talk. We’ve doubled paid parental leave, committed to filling 90% of retail leadership roles internally, expanded Assistant Store Manager roles and invested $500 million in additional partner hours with Green Apron Service. These investments are driving record-low turnover, record-high shift completion, more consistent hours for partners and a growing number of partners recommending Starbucks as a great place to work.
translations: Green Apron Service 全国推广已满一个月，星巴克门店的推广势头正在增强。
项目由门店员工共同参与设计，内容包括更大的门店自主权、增加员工工时和排班人数、Smart Queue 技术、五个关键服务时刻及门店巡访。项目已帮助门店提高早高峰及全天的出杯效率，也为顾客服务留出更多时间。
顾客在咖啡馆、得来速和手机点单等渠道都感受到变化。员工表示，工作更专注、更有成就感。
自“重返星巴克”计划启动以来，公司已增加带薪育儿假，承诺内部填补 90% 的零售管理岗位，扩充副店长岗位，并投入 5 亿美元增加门店员工工时。公司表示，这些投入带来了较低的离职率、较高的排班完成率和更稳定的工时。
fullTextParagraphs: Starbucks chairman and chief executive officer, Brian Niccol, shared the following message with Starbucks partners (employees):

Last week, we celebrated a record-breaking Fall launch. Today, I want to recognize another milestone. We’re one month into the nationwide rollout of Green Apron Service, and the momentum is building in our coffeehouses.

We built Green Apron Service with our green apron partners, and it’s grounded in what you told us you need and what works. It includes more store level ownership, more partner hours, larger rosters, Smart Queue technology, five key moments and coffeehouse walks. It’s already helping us deliver better throughput in the morning and through the balance of day, while creating more time for customer connection and service.

Customers are noticing the difference in every way they access Starbucks — in cafes, in the drive thru and via mobile orders. Partners are telling us it’s making their jobs more focused and more fulfilling. It’s the Starbucks experience at its best, and we are on our way to reclaiming being the world’s greatest customer experience.

Since launching our “Back to Starbucks” plan, we have walked the talk. We’ve doubled paid parental leave, committed to filling 90% of retail leadership roles internally, expanded Assistant Store Manager roles and invested $500 million in additional partner hours with Green Apron Service. These investments are driving record-low turnover, record-high shift completion, more consistent hours for partners and a growing number of partners recommending Starbucks as a great place to work.
Thanks for all you do. Together, we’re building a culture of excellence, customer service and opportunity that makes Starbucks the best job in retail. Let’s keep the green wave going.

scenario.title: 虚构情境练习｜汇报药房新服务流程的首月进展
english: A pharmacy chain is one month into rolling out a new consultation service across its stores.
The service was designed with pharmacists and adds flexible staffing, a private consultation area, and a queue tool.
Customers are getting help sooner, and pharmacists say they have more time to explain medication instructions. Write a short update for regional managers.
chinese: 一家药房连锁正在各门店推广新的咨询服务，目前已满一个月。
该服务由药剂师参与设计，增加了灵活排班、私密咨询区和排队工具。
顾客能更快获得帮助，药剂师也表示有更多时间解释用药说明。请给区域经理写一段简短更新。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请根据 Starbucks CEO 于 2025 年 9 月 8 日发给员工的消息，写三句话：说明 Green Apron Service 当时的推广进度、一线团队获得哪些支持，以及公司报告了哪些早期变化。
firstAttempt.sample: In his September 8, 2025 message, Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol said Green Apron Service had been in its nationwide rollout for one month and that store partners had helped design it. The program included more store-level ownership, additional partner hours, larger rosters, Smart Queue, five key moments, and coffeehouse walks. Starbucks reported better throughput and more time for customer connection; customers noticed changes across cafés, drive-thru, and mobile orders, while partners said their jobs felt more focused.
firstAttempt.rationale: 用公告日期固定“推广一个月”的时间点，再分开报告一线支持和公司/员工反馈，不把早期自述说成独立验证的长期结果。

words.example: The nationwide rollout began in August.

words.meaning: 单位时间内的处理量；效率
words.example: The new queue system improved morning throughput.
words.translation: 新的排队系统提高了早高峰处理效率。

words.meaning: 员工（星巴克对员工的称呼）
words.example: Starbucks partners helped design the new service.
words.translation: 星巴克员工参与设计了这项新服务。

analysis: one month into... 报告项目进度；nationwide rollout 说明推广范围。
and 后面接早期信号，形成“进展 + 当前势头”的简短更新。

Starbucks reported better throughput and more time for customer connection; customers noticed changes across cafés, drive-thru, and mobile orders, while partners said their jobs felt more focused.
